metadata.title: Public Source Registry
metadata.source_policy: Use public, reputable, non-operational sources. Prefer official government/intergovernmental publications, established research institutes, and transparent datasets. Cite every assertion-bearing profile record.

sources.title: Member States
sources.recency_note: Consult at each index refresh.

sources.title: Non-Member States
sources.recency_note: Consult at each index refresh.

sources.title: REST Countries API
sources.recency_note: Used only for basic country metadata; cross-check UN status with UN pages.

sources.title: The World Factbook
sources.recency_note: CIA announced the World Factbook sunset on 2026-02-04; use final/archived/date-stamped pages where possible and record access/as-of dates.

sources.title: factbook.json World Factbook country profiles
sources.recency_note: Public-domain JSON mirror/cache of CIA World Factbook country profiles; use as archived structured factbook context, not as live CIA API.

sources.title: SIPRI Military Expenditure Database
sources.recency_note: Annual updates; keep expenditure year separate from profile as_of_date.

sources.title: The Military Balance
sources.recency_note: Annual reference; may require subscription. Store only derived, cited, non-infringing summaries.

sources.title: United Nations Register of Conventional Arms
sources.publisher: United Nations Office for Disarmament Affairs
sources.recency_note: Use for reported imports/exports and holdings where states submit data; coverage is uneven.

sources.title: World Air Forces directory and public summaries
sources.recency_note: Use only accessible public summaries or licensed data with compliant derived facts.

sources.title: Official procurement, delivery, and service-entry releases
sources.publisher: Country-specific governments, defense ministries, and prime contractors
sources.recency_note: Store country/system-specific URL in row-level source_locator.

sources.title: Public naval vessel registers and official fleet pages
sources.recency_note: Use for commissioned/decommissioned vessel classes and hull-level public facts; avoid live tasking or location.

sources.title: Wikipedia equipment and country military pages
sources.recency_note: Use only as a convenience pointer or low-confidence seed; replace with primary/secondary reputable sources during ingestion.

sources.title: Wikipedia public country and military topic indexes
sources.recency_note: Use for public source discovery and low-confidence context only; prefer primary/established references for final assertions.

sources.title: World Development Indicators
sources.recency_note: Use for population, GDP, transport, energy, and macroeconomic denominators.

sources.title: NATO Member Countries
sources.recency_note: Consult for alliance membership and Article 5 context.

sources.title: National defense ministry / armed forces official public releases
sources.recency_note: Use country-specific URL in source_notes when this family source is cited.

sources.title: United Nations Report on Military Expenditures
sources.publisher: United Nations Office for Disarmament Affairs
sources.recency_note: Government-submitted annual military spending reports; coverage is voluntary and uneven, but rows are official state reports.

sources.title: Arms Trade Treaty Annual Reports
sources.recency_note: Use public annual reports and XLSX exports for declared imports/exports; note if a report is restricted or absent.

sources.title: UN Comtrade HS 93 Arms and Ammunition Trade Records
sources.recency_note: Use for customs trade flows in arms and ammunition categories; do not treat HS codes as exact military inventory.

sources.title: Allied Defence Spending Data from 1949 to Present
sources.recency_note: Annual NATO compendium in PDF/Excel with financial, personnel, and economic data for member countries.

sources.title: Defence Data Portal
sources.recency_note: Annual EDA data supplied by EU Member State Ministries of Defence; use for EU spending, personnel, investment, R&D, and benchmark fields.

sources.title: Vienna Document confidence- and security-building measures
sources.publisher: Organization for Security and Co-operation in Europe
sources.recency_note: Use for public framework, notification, inspection, and annual exchange process metadata; public data availability varies by participating State.

sources.title: Troop and Police Contributors
sources.recency_note: Monthly official country contribution reports for UN peacekeeping and special political missions; use as dated public snapshots only.

sources.title: United Nations Treaty Collection
sources.recency_note: Use for treaty signature, ratification, accession, reservation, and depositary status relevant to legal and political constraints.

sources.title: Safeguards Agreements and Legal Framework
sources.recency_note: Use for safeguards agreement and non-proliferation legal context; avoid facility-level operational details.

sources.title: Major Arms Sales notifications
sources.recency_note: Use for country, system, package, estimated value, and notification date; post-February 2026 notices may move to U.S. State Department pages.

sources.title: DSCA Historical Sales Book
sources.recency_note: Use for country/program historical foreign military sales totals and long-run security cooperation context.

sources.title: Arms Sales Congressional Notifications
sources.recency_note: Use for U.S. arms-sale congressional notifications where State Department becomes the publication endpoint; record the DSCA/State transition in row notes.

sources.title: USAspending API
sources.recency_note: Use for U.S. federal award and contract data; filter defense rows carefully and cite API query parameters in source_locator.

sources.title: SAM.gov Contract Awards API
sources.recency_note: Use for public U.S. contract award records and procurement cross-checks; record query filters and award identifiers.

sources.title: World Port Index
sources.recency_note: Use for public port locations, facilities, services, and maritime infrastructure context; do not infer military tasking.

sources.title: Geographic Names Server
sources.publisher: U.S. National Geospatial-Intelligence Agency / U.S. Board on Geographic Names
sources.recency_note: Use for standardized foreign geographic names, variants, and approximate feature locations; coordinates are finding aids.

sources.title: Logistics Performance Index
sources.recency_note: Use for country-level logistics, customs, infrastructure, tracking, timeliness, and trade-lane context; not a military logistics inventory.

sources.title: Global Dynamic Land Cover
sources.recency_note: Use for terrain and land-cover modifiers in simulation geography layers; keep derived military movement assumptions separate.

sources.title: Shuttle Radar Topography Mission global elevation data
sources.recency_note: Use for global elevation, slope, and terrain constraints; cite product/version and processing assumptions in derived rows.

sources.title: Government Finance Statistics
sources.recency_note: Use for COFOG defense and public finance series where available; reconcile definitions with NATO, SIPRI, and national budgets.

sources.title: Government expenditure by function (COFOG)
sources.publisher: Organisation for Economic Co-operation and Development
sources.recency_note: Use for OECD and partner government expenditure by function, including defense; align year and COFOG definitions explicitly.

sources.title: EU annual arms export public database and reports
sources.recency_note: Use for EU arms export licenses, denials, and annual public reporting where available; member-state coverage and granularity vary.

sources.title: Trade Map
sources.recency_note: Use for trade indicators and mirror/direct trade flows where licensing permits; weapons-specific analysis should be cross-checked with UN Comtrade and ATT/UNROCA.

sources.title: Wikidata Query Service
sources.recency_note: Use as a structured public index for entity linking, equipment aliases, manufacturers, and country relationships; upgrade factual assertions to stronger sources.

sources.title: DBpedia SPARQL endpoint
sources.recency_note: Use as a structured encyclopedia-derived index and alias source; prefer primary or established secondary sources for final inventory assertions.

sources.title: Country Studies
sources.recency_note: Use for historical institutional, geographic, and country context where currentness is not required; do not use as live equipment inventory.

sources.title: Curated disputed and partially recognized entity status list
sources.recency_note: Must be reviewed manually against UN, ISO, and reputable area studies sources.

sources.title: AdaptSim public schema and generated coverage metadata
sources.recency_note: Used only for schema/category/action definitions and generated coverage rows; factual military assertions require external source IDs.
